scientific_conclusion: The fixed archived B3LYP continuous vertical-gap regression is coherent. This is not experimental/CC accuracy, a ground-state certification, or an uncontaminated hidden holdout. The source/protocol change must be disclosed to reviewers; old CSD rights remain unresolved.
